evidence.quote: Eventually it is revealed that Eugene is not a scientist , but a high school science teacher , and that he does n't know how to cure the virus but lied to manipulate the other survivors into taking him to Washington D.C. believing it to be the best chance for survival .

In the comics , Eugene is an overweight high school science teacher prior to the apocalypse . Post-apocalypse , he utilizes his intelligence to pretend to be a scientist in order to gain the protection of others . He has no survival skills of his own . His TV counterpart also claimed to be a scientist before revealing his deception .

evidence.quote: Since then , at least one of the turkeys presented to the President has been taken to a farm where it will live out the rest of its natural life .
The 2013 , 2014 and 2015 turkeys were sent to Morven Park in Leesburg , Virginia , the estate of former Virginia governor ( and prolific turkey farmer ) Westmoreland Davis .
rather than serving solely as tourist attractions , the turkeys are now placed in the care of experts who make conscious efforts to maintain the turkeys ' health for as long as possible .

evidence.quote: The Path is an American drama web television series created by Jessica Goldberg and starring Aaron Paul , Michelle Monaghan , and Hugh Dancy . The show portrays members of a fictional religion known as Meyerism .
